deviations.note: Every OrFS failing assertion is either mechanically explained ('unsupported_node_types': the test creates a FIFO/block/char/socket node, which OrFS rejects with EOPNOTSUPP) or is a documented deviation listed in scripts/posix/pjdfstest-expected.tsv (reasons in documented_deviations). 'shared_with_reference' means the reference filesystem fails the same assertion. The gate fails on any unclassified failure or any allowlisted assertion that no longer fails.

unsupported_node_types.rationale: OrFS represents only regular files, directories and symlinks. mknod(2) for S_IFIFO/S_IFCHR/S_IFBLK/S_IFSOCK returns EOPNOTSUPP (docs/FUSE-SEMANTICS.md §5). pjdfstest files that create FIFO/block/char/socket nodes are therefore recorded as unsupported rather than failures.
